papers.title: Associations of drinking water per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances with cause-specific mortality in men with prostate cancer
papers.summary: We found 1 imprecise *p* value out of 3 detected *p* values.

findings.sentence: We found moderate correlations for PFOA (r=0.44, p<.001) and PFOS (r=0.33, p <.01) but weaker correlations for PFNA (r=0.03), which may have been due to the strong skew in PFNA drinking water predicted values.

papers.title: Food-level dietary factors reveal cardiometabolic risk hidden by diet quality scores.
papers.summary: We found 3 imprecise *p* values out of 14 detected *p* values.

findings.sentence: Pre-specified subgroup analyses tested interactions with sex, age, BMI, smoking status and ethnicity; no interaction survived correction for multiple testing (9 of 120 tests nominally significant at P < 0.05, none at Bonferroni-corrected P < 4.2 x 10 -4 ; Supplementary Files 9-10).

Of those, 413 (33.7%) replicated in the held-out dataset (Bonferroni-corrected P <0.05), consistent with prior diet-metabolite studies 20, 21 and with concordant effect sizes between datasets (Fig. 4a).
An association was considered replicated if P <0.05 with the same direction of effect.
